Set the default third-party model here; the CLI's global config is not changed.
ui.models.is-a-local-or-lan-address-allo: “{0}” is a local or LAN address. Allow Nomi to access it?
ui.models.key-limits-leave-blank-for-no-: Key limits (leave blank for no limit; extra requests queue, then move to the next key)
ui.models.limits-unknown-hint: This model's context window wasn't found, so 128K is assumed. You can enter it under Advanced.
ui.models.lists-the-models-enabled-under: Lists the models enabled under Settings → Models.
ui.models.local-services-don-t-need-a-ke: Local services don't need a key.
ui.models.long-context-by-default-for: Turn on long context by default for {0}
ui.models.long-context-costs-more: Requests beyond the standard window cost more

ui.models.long-context-price: Requests over {0} are billed at {1}/M input (standard {2}/M)

ui.models.models-data-builtin-status: Using the built-in model catalog ({0}) · {1} models

ui.models.no-model-list-was-returned-go-: No model list was returned. Enter a test model and try again.

ui.models.no-third-party-providers-yet-a: No third-party providers yet. Add one and Nomi chat can use its models.
ui.models.nomi-will-add-the-command-fold: Nomi will add the command folder to your user PATH. Turning this off removes only the folder Nomi added, preserving existing entries and other environment variables.

ui.models.not-on-path-yet-run-the-comman: Not on PATH yet. Run the commands by full path, or add the folder to PATH.
ui.models.official-uses-the-cli-s-own-ac: "Official" uses the CLI's own account; "Third-party" goes through the Nomi gateway. Only the current tab is affected, starting with the next message.
ui.models.on-windows-nomi-doesn-t-change: On Windows, Nomi doesn't change PATH. Add the folder above to your user PATH environment variable manually.
ui.models.one-third-party-provider-can-s: One third-party provider can serve Nomi chat and every coding assistant at once; Nomi converts between APIs automatically. Official account sign-in and switching stay on the Coding assistants page.
ui.models.paste-the-new-key-it-replaces-: Paste the new key; it replaces {0} when you save

ui.models.restrict-models-to-apis-none-c: Restrict models to APIs (none checked = automatic)
ui.models.s-responses-api-rejects-custom: {0}'s Responses API rejects custom tools; converting instead
ui.models.switching-restarts-this-tab-s-: Takes effect from the next message by restarting this tab's assistant; the conversation is kept
ui.models.sync-on-startup: Sync on startup (when last checked over 12 hours ago)
ui.models.the-addresses-changed-detectin: The addresses changed; detecting again is recommended.
ui.models.third-party-reasoning-can-t-be: This tab and its conversation stay as they are. Third-party reasoning can't be sent to the official API, so the CLI continues in a fresh session that carries the conversation so far. Continue?
ui.models.this-name-looks-like-a-key-the: This name looks like a key. The name is only a label; it doesn't change the key used for requests.
ui.models.this-provider-comes-from-envir: This provider comes from environment variables and is read-only. To change it, edit the environment variables and restart Nomi.
ui.models.this-tab-uses-a-third-party-mo: This tab uses a third-party model (through the Nomi gateway).
ui.models.use-it-to-replace-this-key-ins: Use it to replace this key instead
ui.models.use-third-party-models-in-a-te: Use third-party models in a terminal with commands such as nomi-claude and nomi-codex; running claude or codex directly still uses your official sign-in.
ui.models.used-for-helper-requests-such-: Used for helper requests such as titles, summaries and next-prompt suggestions; usually a cheaper model from the same provider
ui.models.when-on-parameters-the-model-d: When on, parameters the model doesn't support (such as reasoning effort or temperature) cause an error; when off, the gateway removes or adjusts them and notes it in Recent requests
ui.models.when-this-provider-s-models-al: When this provider's models all fail, use the models below in order.
